{{Top|leg}}
A '''hand scanner''' was a portable [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Science]] team [[MS-133]] used a hand scanner during the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] dig on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] along with other equipment including an [[electronic scale]] and a [[fine particle blower]].
